data.title: S3 Toolbox
data.notes: Upload, download, move, copy, list, grep, and delete your files in S3 buckets.

params.title: Region ID
params.caption: The AWS Region ID where your bucket resides, e.g. `us-east-1`.

params.title: Bucket Name
params.caption: The name of your S3 bucket, e.g. `mybucket01`.

params.title: Custom API Endpoint
params.caption: Optionally override the S3 API endpoint, for services such as B2, MinIO, RustFS, Garage, SeaweedFS, etc.

tools.title: Upload Files
tools.description: Upload job input files to an S3 bucket.

fields.title: Local Path
fields.caption: The local path to find files under.  Leave blank to use the job temp directory and job input files.

fields.title: Filename Pattern
fields.caption: Optionally filter the input files using a glob pattern, applied to the filenames.

fields.title: Remote Path
fields.caption: The base S3 path to store files under.  Leave blank to store at the root level.

fields.title: Compress Files (Gzip)
fields.caption: Optionally gzip-compress all files before upload.  This also adds a `.gz` filename suffix.

fields.title: Custom S3 Params
fields.caption: Optionally specify parameters to the S3 API, for e.g. ACL and Storage Class.

tools.title: Download Files
tools.description: Download S3 files and attach to the job output.

fields.title: Remote Path
fields.caption: The base S3 path to fetch files from.  Leave blank to fetch files at the root level.

fields.title: Filename Pattern
fields.caption: Optionally filter the remote files using a glob pattern, applied to the filenames.

fields.title: Local Path
fields.caption: The local path to save files in.  Leave blank to use the job temp directory.

fields.title: Decompress Files (Gunzip)
fields.caption: Optionally decompress all gzipped files after download.  This also strips the `.gz` filename suffix if found.

fields.title: Delete Files
fields.caption: Optionally delete all remote S3 files after successful download.

fields.title: Attach Files
fields.caption: Optionally attach all downloaded files to the job output.

fields.title: Maximum Files
fields.caption: Optionally set a maximum number of files to download.

fields.title: Sort Files
fields.value: Newest First [newest], Oldest First [oldest], Largest First [largest], Smallest First [smallest]
fields.caption: Optionally sort the files before downloading.  Useful when combined with maximum.

fields.title: Remote Path
fields.caption: The base S3 path to fetch files from.  Leave blank to fetch files at the root level.

fields.title: Filename Pattern
fields.caption: Optionally filter the remote files using a glob pattern, applied to the filenames.

fields.title: Older Than
fields.caption: Optionally filter the S3 files based on their mod date, so they must be older than the specified number of seconds (or specify a string like `7 days`).

fields.title: Maximum Files
fields.caption: Optionally set a maximum limit on the number of files to delete.

fields.title: Sort Files
fields.value: Oldest First [oldest], Newest First [newest], Largest First [largest], Smallest First [smallest]
fields.caption: Optionally sort the files before deleting.  Useful when combined with maximum.

fields.title: Dry Run
fields.caption: When checked, will perform a 'dry run' and not actually perform the deletes.

tools.title: Move Files
tools.description: Move remote S3 files to another path and/or bucket.

fields.title: Remote Path
fields.caption: The base S3 path to move files from.  Leave blank to move files from the root level.

fields.title: Filename Pattern
fields.caption: Optionally filter the remote files using a glob pattern, applied to the filenames.

fields.title: Destination Path
fields.caption: The base S3 path to move files to.  Leave blank to keep the same relative path at the destination root.

fields.title: Destination Bucket
fields.caption: Optionally override the destination bucket name.  Leave blank to use the source bucket configured above.

fields.title: Maximum Files
fields.caption: Optionally set a maximum limit on the number of files to move.

fields.title: Sort Files
fields.value: Oldest First [oldest], Newest First [newest], Largest First [largest], Smallest First [smallest]
fields.caption: Optionally sort the files before moving.  Useful when combined with maximum.

fields.title: Custom S3 Params
fields.caption: Optionally specify parameters to the S3 API for the destination objects, for e.g. ACL and Storage Class.

fields.title: Dry Run
fields.caption: When checked, will perform a 'dry run' and not actually perform the moves.

tools.title: Copy Files
tools.description: Copy remote S3 files to another path and/or bucket.

fields.title: Remote Path
fields.caption: The base S3 path to copy files from.  Leave blank to copy files from the root level.

fields.title: Filename Pattern
fields.caption: Optionally filter the remote files using a glob pattern, applied to the filenames.

fields.title: Destination Path
fields.caption: The base S3 path to copy files to.  Leave blank to keep the same relative path at the destination root.

fields.title: Destination Bucket
fields.caption: Optionally override the destination bucket name.  Leave blank to use the source bucket configured above.

fields.title: Maximum Files
fields.caption: Optionally set a maximum limit on the number of files to copy.

fields.title: Sort Files
fields.value: Oldest First [oldest], Newest First [newest], Largest First [largest], Smallest First [smallest]
fields.caption: Optionally sort the files before copying.  Useful when combined with maximum.

fields.title: Custom S3 Params
fields.caption: Optionally specify parameters to the S3 API for the destination objects, for e.g. ACL and Storage Class.

tools.title: List Files
tools.description: List remote S3 files with optional filter, and return metadata.

fields.title: Remote Path
fields.caption: The base S3 path to list files from.  Leave blank to list files at the root level.

fields.title: Filename Pattern
fields.caption: Optionally filter the remote files using a glob pattern, applied to the filenames.

fields.title: Older Than
fields.caption: Optionally filter the S3 files based on their mod date, so they must be older than the specified number of seconds (or specify a string like `7 days`).

fields.title: Newer Than
fields.caption: Optionally filter the S3 files based on their mod date, so they must be newer than the specified number of seconds (or specify a string like `7 days`).

fields.title: Maximum Files
fields.caption: Optionally set a maximum number of files to return.

fields.title: Sort Files
fields.value: Newest First [newest], Oldest First [oldest], Largest First [largest], Smallest First [smallest]
fields.caption: Optionally sort the files before returning metadata.

tools.title: Grep Files
tools.description: Search inside remote S3 files for regular expression match.

fields.title: Remote Path
fields.caption: The base S3 path to search under.  Leave blank to search from the root level.

fields.title: Filename Pattern
fields.caption: Optionally filter the remote files using a glob pattern, applied to the filenames.

fields.title: Match Pattern (Regex)
fields.caption: The regular expression pattern to search for inside each remote file.

fields.title: Decompress Files (Gunzip)
fields.caption: Automatically decompress all gzipped files during download before searching their contents.

fields.title: Older Than
fields.caption: Optionally filter the S3 files based on their mod date, so they must be older than the specified number of seconds (or specify a string like `7 days`).

fields.title: Newer Than
fields.caption: Optionally filter the S3 files based on their mod date, so they must be newer than the specified number of seconds (or specify a string like `7 days`).

fields.title: Maximum Matches
fields.caption: Optionally stop after this many matching lines have been found.

fields.title: Output Format
fields.caption: Select whether you want the matched lines returned as job JSON data, or attached as a text file.
